title: HardwareOS | Plan it. Wire it. Build it
excerpt: Plan it. Wire it. Build it. Describe a device and HardwareOS picks catalog-backed parts, wires them to your board, writes the firmware and compiles it.
content_html:
Your imagination has a workbench now

Build the thing
you can’t stop
thinking about.

HardwareOS turns a product idea into a build plan: parts, wiring, firmware, and a clear path to the bench.

01 / WHY WE’RE HERE

Good hardware ideas deserve more than a sketch and a dozen search tabs.

Give yours a real build plan.

Boards indexed
4,000+

Parts indexed
20,000+

Wiring-ready
3,000+

02 / HOW IT WORKS

Start with the outcome. HardwareOS maps the system and gives you a buildable place to begin.

  1. 01

    Describe the outcome

    Tell HardwareOS what the device needs to do in plain language.

  2. 02

    Map the system

    Work through parts, connections, code, and tradeoffs in one place.

  3. 03

    Build with a plan

    Leave with a concrete build path, not another open tab.

04 / START

Built for people who make things.

Pick a proven starting point or write your own brief. HardwareOS carries the context into the workbench, ready to refine into a build plan.

DESCRIBE WHAT YOU WANT TO BUILD

Enter to continue

Select a starting point below to load a concrete brief.

05 / YOUR TURN

Start building
with a real plan.

Open your workbench

Bring the idea. We will help you make the first decisions.
